item.title: Page Image Alignment
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to image alignment! The best way to demonstrate the ebb and flow of the various image positioning options is to nestle them snuggly among an ocean of words. Grab a paddle and let's get started. On the topic of alignment, it should be noted that users can choose from the options of None, Left, Right, and Center. In addition, they also get the options of Thumbnail, Medium, Large & Fullsize.

The image above happens to be centered. The rest of this paragraph is filler for the sake of seeing the text wrap around the 150x150 image, which is left aligned. As you can see the should be some space above, below, and to the right of the image. The text should not be creeping on the image. Creeping is just not right. Images need breathing room too. Let them speak like you words. Let them do their jobs without any hassle from the text. In about one more sentence here, we'll see that the text moves from the right of the image down below the image in seamless transition. Again, letting the do it's thang. Mission accomplished! And now for a massively large image. It also has no alignment. The image above, though 1200px wide, should not overflow the content area. It should remain contained with no visible disruption to the flow of content. And now we're going to shift things to the right align. Again, there should be plenty of room above, below, and to the left of the image. Just look at him there... Hey guy! Way to rock that right side. I don't care what the left aligned image says, you look great. Don't let anyone else tell you differently. In just a bit here, you should see the text start to wrap below the right aligned image and settle in nicely. There should still be plenty of room and everything should be sitting pretty. Yeah... Just like that. It never felt so good to be right. And just when you thought we were done, we're going to do them all over again with captions! [caption id="attachment_906" align="aligncenter" width="580"] Look at 580x300 getting some caption love.[/caption] The image above happens to be centered. The caption also has a link in it, just to see if it does anything funky. [caption id="attachment_904" align="alignleft" width="150"] Itty-bitty caption.[/caption] The rest of this paragraph is filler for the sake of seeing the text wrap around the 150x150 image, which is left aligned. As you can see the should be some space above, below, and to the right of the image. The text should not be creeping on the image. Creeping is just not right. Images need breathing room too. Let them speak like you words. Let them do their jobs without any hassle from the text. In about one more sentence here, we'll see that the text moves from the right of the image down below the image in seamless transition. Again, letting the do it's thang. Mission accomplished! And now for a massively large image. It also has no alignment. [caption id="attachment_907" align="alignnone" width="1200"] Massive image comment for your eyeballs.[/caption] The image above, though 1200px wide, should not overflow the content area. It should remain contained with no visible disruption to the flow of content. [caption id="attachment_905" align="alignright" width="300"] Feels good to be right all the time.[/caption] And now we're going to shift things to the right align. Again, there should be plenty of room above, below, and to the left of the image. Just look at him there... Hey guy! Way to rock that right side. I don't care what the left aligned image says, you look great. Don't let anyone else tell you differently. In just a bit here, you should see the text start to wrap below the right aligned image and settle in nicely. There should still be plenty of room and everything should be sitting pretty. Yeah... Just like that. It never felt so good to be right. And that's a wrap, yo! You survived the tumultuous waters of alignment. Image alignment achievement unlocked!

Whether you’d like to stop in before work, at lunch, after work, or on the weekend, we are ready to serve you. It is not easy to plan or schedule for a tech issue nor are you prepared for it. Disaster strikes when it decides to and we are here to work with your schedule. Pop in at your convenience and we’ll provide a free diagnostic and speed fix after.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-wrench" add_icon="true" title="Same Day Repair" tab_id="1551053862180-37775f55-6209"][vc_column_text]

PC Repairs

Get a free diagnostic on the spot to repair your PC. The turn-around time is the same day to next day. You need your computer fixed right away and we will make that happen for you. Commonly supported Microsoft Windows / PC issues:

Computer is slow or freezes

Computer will not boot up

Cannot access Internet or email

Computer virus / spyware

Laptop shuts down on its own

Spilled Liquid on Laptop

Broken laptop screen

Getting a blue screen / error message

Can’t charge laptop

Hardware issues / software issues

Windows updates issue

Won’t start up / won’t power up

Windows error pop-up

Won’t shut down / sleep

Drop-off or Onsite Windows / Microsoft repair service: You choose

Whether you prefer a free diagnostic first or same-day visit, we will accommodate you. We will work around your schedule. You may schedule for one of our Computer Repair 1 Microsoft repair service experts to come to your home or office during the same day. Or you may drop in anytime at our PC repair Location on google in Brisbane Either way, you will get a certified Windows PC repair expert take care of your Microsoft issue.

Why choose Computer Repair 1 over Microsoft?

Our Computer Repair 1 Microsoft repair service experts will get the job done right and much faster. Plain and simple. With Microsoft, you will need to call up and take the time to explain your Windows issue to at least 3 different departments. Then, more time will be wasted to have a Microsoft rep remote into your computer. Finally, you’ll need to hope and pray your computer isn’t screwed up worse than it is. We know first-hand since we’ve cleaned up Microsoft’s shoddy repair attempts many times. Why is Computer Repair 1 better than your PC manufacturer? If you’re thinking of Dell, HP, Lenovo, Sony, Toshiba, Acer, Asus or another PC manufacturer, think again. In most cases, you’ll need to ship your computer into the repair depot. This is only a good service if you have 2-4 weeks to spare. On the other hand, if you want to fix your computer in the same day without any hassles, go to Computer Repair 1 for the best Microsoft repair service in Brisbane.  Our PC technicians are certified to work on all the major manufacturer Windows laptops and desktops, and are able to begin fixing your computer as soon as you ask us to.  No red tape, no overcharging, and no tech speak.  Instead, you’ll get straightforward PC repair service and costs that you can trust.
Services and prices for Walk-in Service – $150 – Free Diagnostic
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-map-marker" add_icon="true" title="Locations" tab_id="1551053862990-38b802dc-4636"][vc_column_text]Indro - Indooroopilly - Toowong - St.Lucia - UQ Campus - Graceville - Sherwood - Chelmer - Auchenflower - Milton - Spring Hill - East Brisbane - Yeronga - Teneriffe - New Farm[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-ambulance" add_icon="true" title="On-Site" tab_id="1551053864019-f83e0ed5-fdc3"][vc_column_text]

Onsite Business IT Support

Network down?  No Internet?  Computer virus?  Computer slow or not working?  Need to set up a new PC or Mac?  Computer Repair 1 will take care of all your home or office IT needs.  Our motto of “treating ever customer’s computer like it is our own mother’s computer” will, in effect, provide you with personalised, friendly, professional, and trustworthy computer repair service.  Get competent, affordable, fast computer service Computer Repair 1 now.

Be covered for all your company’s computer needs.

Office computer repair and business IT service at its best.   Computer Repair 1 Help provides reliable and timely business computer support services.  Whether you have a critical IT issue, a project, or would like periodic IT maintenance, we will provide the optimal solution to meet your company’s goals and objectives.  We look forward to developing a long and successful relationship with you and your company. Technical issues and projects may seem daunting.  Don’t worry, we will make your life easier and take away this pressure.  You will received a well-informed assessment and qualified solution to ensure your company’s network is performing optimally.  Our technical experts have experience with resolving all office computer issues and preventing future ones.  We are certified in installing and upgrading networks.  Contact us for an assessment, IT solution, and server/network projects.

Office PC/Mac repairs.  Tune-ups.  Virus removals.  Back-ups.  Security.

Get your office computer repair issues taken care of fast and on the first try.  Leave all your office IT support to us so you can get back to your other priorities at work.  We will come onsite, on time, and ready to meet all of your company  IT service objectives.  That’s the way you should expect onsite business IT support.  On time and done perfectly.  Consider us your in-house computer service team.  We are just a phone call, email, or click away!
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-laptop" add_icon="true" title="Mac Repair" tab_id="1551053864997-59aa4def-32b1"][vc_column_text]
Mac Repairs We love Apple and the fantastic products they create and we pride ourselves in being experts at fixing all things Mac. Stop in for an affordable, speedy reliable Mac repair service in Brisbane. You may bring your Apple device to our  computer repair spot for a free diagnostic and quick turn-around. If you prefer to have a Computer Repair 1 Mac repair technician come to you, contact us to schedule same-day IT service. My Mac is so slow. Slow boot up and constant pinwheeling could indicate a problem with your Mac. At Computer Repair 1 , you may drop in at your convenience with no appointment necessary. Time is of the essence and we get that. Your Mac needs help and we want to fix it right away for you. My MacBook doesn’t turn on. We’ll be happy to provide a free on-the-spot diagnostic for all power-related issues. We are able to directly repair the logic board and perform part replacements to help get you back up and running. Just need an adapter? We sell those too. I just spilled water on my MacBook Air. Can you help? Computer Repair 1 routinely performs Mac spill clean repairs and is able to save you hundreds of dollars by directly removing the spill damage. Further, data recovery is one of our specialties if you simply need your stuff back. My iMac needs a repair. Can you come to my home or office? Computer Repair 1 gladly has a enough tech team that will be able to assist you in the same day. You’ll receive a  Apple technician who will take care of all your Apple repair needs. I need to upgrade my MacBook. You want to extend the life of your MacBook and we’re here to help achieve that, regardless of its age. At Computer Repair 1, we are service-focused and will do everything in our power to repair, upgrade, and save your precious MacBook. Do you work on older vintage Apple products? Apple products are typically very well made and retain their value for years longer than other computer manufacturers. As such, we are happy to service your vintage Apple products and breathe new life into them!
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-tint" add_icon="true" title="Water Damaged Mac Repair" tab_id="1551053865560-3e8cbd4d-7fa1"][vc_column_text]Spill damage repair
For some reason, Macs love liquids.  It’s the truth!  We get tons of MacBooks in every day at our Mac repair Computer Repair 1 with a serious drinking problem.  That’s okay though.  We have a revolutionary way to repair Mac spills.  It costs a fraction of what Apple charges and it works. Why should you use Computer Repair 1’s Mac spill repair service?
  • We directly repair your affected parts.
  • We will repair your damaged logic board.
  • We only charge you if your Mac is fixed.
  • You will receive an affordable solution.
Mac models supported: MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air
MacBook Spill Damage Repair Costs:  $150 plus parts
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-database" add_icon="true" title="Mac Data Recovery" tab_id="1551054572971-940dea8f-a777"][vc_column_text]

Data Recovery

Macs are well-built, but can still crash too.  You can count on us as your dedicated MacBook and iMac data recovery service.  No waiting or taking a number here.  Just come into our Apple service centre when disaster strikes and we’ll be happy to recover your files. We recover files from the following Mac issues:
  • Spinning wheel
  • Clicking hard drive
  • Flashing question mark
  • Start-up error
  • MacBook spill
  • Kernel panic
  • Accidentally deleted files
  • MacBook drop/fall
No matter how old or new, and what type of Mac it is, we will recover your files.  Data recovery is performed on all models, including:MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, and Mac Pro.  It’s an easy process.  Just drop in for a free data recovery diagnostic and quick recovery turn-around.  No data, no charge. So what’s next?  What’s the Mac data recovery process?
  • Bring over your Mac in question.
  • Get a free data recovery flat fee cost along with an estimate of time.
  • Decide if you’d like to proceed.
  • If not, there’s no charge.
  • If you approve, we proceed with the Mac data recovery service.
  • Expect it to be ready the same day up to 3-5 days as our typical response time.
  • If we cannot recover your Mac hard drive files, there is no charge.
Mac models supported: MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Pro, Mac mini
Mac Data Recovery Cost: $150-250
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome="fa fa-handshake-o" add_icon="true" title="Business IT SUPPORT" tab_id="1551054573890-1d952a87-3113"][vc_column_text]

Scheduled IT Computer Maintenance

Waiting until something breaks is typically not going to help your performance or bottom line. Being a step ahead of any computer issues is our specialty. One size doesn’t fit all and we get that. We will customise a computer maintenance  plan for you and ensure your computers and network are up and running the way they should be.

Schedule your office computer maintenance service now.

Make sure your business is well taken care of by having one of our Business IT Technicians maintain your network periodically. You’ll receive the same IT rep going forward along with two to three alternates as extra coverage for emergency issues. In the long run, your business performance will increase and so will your bottom line. You will certainly benefit from our office computer maintenance service.

Need help right away and don’t have time to travel to us?

Get remote support now. Set up a remote session so we can remotely access your computer to fix it. Common issues we remotely fix are:
  • Viruses
  • Pop-ups
  • Slow computer
  • Can’t print
  • Need to set up / migrate email
  • Configure software
  • Tune up and optimize

Managed IT Support Services

Prefer to know your monthly IT budget?  Prefer to have an IT company take care of your computer network?  No problem!  We have you covered.  Better yet, take less than a minute to calculate what your IT costs will be every month.  Quick, easy, and reliable.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Capabilities" tab_id="1551054574640-f8dcd725-b6a6"][vc_column_text]

Our Capabilities:

Outsourced IT Providing customized IT support for networks
Helpdesk / Desktop Support Receive phone support / remote / on premises computer support
Software/Hardware Deployment Project help, roll-outs, upgrades, installations, migrations
IT Managed Services Allow us to be your one point of contact for all IT services
Server / Network Setups New installs, upgrades, integrations, connecting all devices
Computer Break/Fix Repairs Get your PCs and Macs repaired. Includes parts replacements.
Operations and Maintenance Proactively maintaining network systems on an operational level
IT Recruitment We will well-match IT candidates for your job requirements
IT Services Certified technicians experienced in your specific IT tasks
Other Computer Services Got another IT request?  We’re probably qualified to support it.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Computer won't start" tab_id="1551054779215-65950f9e-2f7a"][vc_column_text]

Computer won’t start

Does your computer fail to power on?  Or the operating system isn’t loading all the way?  Maybe you see lights, but your computer is not showing anything on the screen?  Our Computer Repair 1 experts will diagnose it, test all your parts and operating system to determine the exact issue and repair cost.  We are computer experts at determining non-starting computer issues.

Common computer start-up issues we support:

  • Failed power supply
  • No power light
  • Failing hard drive
  • Dead motherboard
  • Overheated computer
  • Bad RAM / Memory
  • Failed processor
  • Non-working fan
  • Windows corruption
  • Virus infection
  • Dropped laptop

I’m getting no power on my computer.

This may be as simple as replacing the power supply, battery, charger or RAM.  Or you may have some critical motherboard, laptop jack, component failure.  We do all of the above and are happy to provide a free diagnostic to determine why your computer won’t power on.

My computer doesn’t load the operating system all the way.

In this case, there’s a little bit more hope in that it’s not a serious catastrophe.  You may have a Windows or Mac operating system corruption, PC virus infection, or hard drive issue.  Let our PC and Mac repair specialists check this out for you.

My laptop gets power, but I can’t see anything on the screen.

This is usually a screen issue and we stock parts in-house for quick laptop screen replacements.  Of course, this may also mean the inverter, video connector, or other display issues are present.

My Computer Won’t Start.  What first steps should I take?

  1. First, don’t fret.  It may be an easy fix.  Make sure your plug or AC Adapter is plugged in and secure in the back of your computer.  Maybe it is loose.
  2. Secondly, make sure the other end of your power cable or charger is securely in a wall socket or power strip.  Try another outlet in case one outlet is bad.
  3. Press the power button again.  Maybe you’ll get lucky this time.
  If no luck, bring in your non-powering computer to our Computer Won’t Start Repair Computer Repair 1 location for a free diagnostic and computer repair.  Most repairs are fixed within hours. Please note:  If your computer gets no power whatsoever, we recommend walking in for a free diagnostic.  That way, we can inform you what the cost and any necessary parts that are needed.  We are happy to come onsite, but it may require a 2-visit service if special parts need to be ordered.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_tabs][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_toggle title="SSD replacement for Old Computer"]
Old Spin Mechanical Drivers also not forever, 5-6 years old heavy usage
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Is it Worth to Fix Old Broken Computer?"]
Sometimes we should just recover data from old broken computer and buy new computer or buy good second hand computer (saving huge amount of money)
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Is it worth replacing laptop screen?"]
Sometimes yes but most cases not worth it. Depends on your computer model and year. Unless it was a new laptop and the fall destroyed pretty much everything, you can consider that price a rip-off. Replacing a laptop screen, including parts and labor, shouldn’t cost you more than $400. In fact, it will probably come in closer to $300.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="When should you replace your computer?"]
You should expect to replace your computer once every four years. That’s based on a cost analysis, plus the average time it takes to wear out the internal parts of the computer. Home Computer Help gives a slightly different estimate: Five years for desktops, and three to four for laptops.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="How much does it cost to fix my computer?"]$150 plus parts.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="How much does it cost to refurbish a laptop?"]
Depends on what parts need replacement, Most cases Hard drive replacement to Solid State Drive, SSDs cost quite cheap these days. Plus cloning your existing system to brand new Solid State, does the job. $100-$150 plus SSD cost, (1TB SSD cost roughly $170 – Umart Shop) Cleaning CPU Fan and Replacing Heatsink paste reduce heating and increasing performance. Adding RAM memory, These days Google Chrome, Firefox using a lot ram memory. Upgrading Graphics Card, Crypto Currency Mining become expensive and worthless and GPU prices goes down and actual price, so it’s good time to upgrade. Replacing CPU fan or cleaning maintain.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Can a computer be fixed after water damage?"]
Water or other liquid can cause a computer battery to short out, which can damage the power plug and affect the power supply to the house. However, before writing off the water–damaged computer or taking it to a costly repairman, try the following steps to fix it.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="How much does it cost to fix water damaged laptop?"]
$150 plus parts if necessary
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="How much does data recovery cost?"]
$150-$300 (mostly $150)
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Can you upgrade a old desktop?"]
Upgrade Your Hardware (If You Can) Obviously, the best way to speed up an old, slow computer is to upgrade the hardware. This isn’t always possible in laptops or certain desktops, but you should always be able to upgrade the RAM and hard drive.  Please call us for Free Consultation and Advise.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column][/vc_row]

How to Prevent a Broken Laptop Display

Trendy Computer Problems and Solutions

Common Computer Problems and Easy Fixes

1. Slow Computer Performance:

  • Problem: Sluggish response times, slow boot-ups, and lagging applications.
  • Solution:
    • Clean up your system: Remove unnecessary files, programs, and browser extensions.
    • Update software: Keep your operating system and software up-to-date.
    • Upgrade hardware: Consider adding more RAM or a faster SSD.
    • Optimize settings: Adjust power settings and disable unnecessary startup programs.

2. Wi-Fi Connectivity Issues:

  • Problem: Weak Wi-Fi signal, frequent disconnections, or slow internet speeds.
  • Solution:
    • Restart your router: A simple restart can often resolve connectivity issues.
    • Check for interference: Move your router away from electronic devices that may interfere with the signal.
    • Update router firmware: Keep your router's firmware up-to-date for optimal performance.
    • Use a Wi-Fi extender: Boost your Wi-Fi signal in areas with weak coverage.

3. Overheating:

  • Problem: High temperatures can lead to system instability and hardware damage.
  • Solution:
    • Clean your computer: Remove dust and debris from the fans and vents.
    • Check fan performance: Ensure that the fans are working properly.
    • Improve airflow: Elevate your laptop or use a cooling pad.
    • Monitor temperatures: Use software to track your computer's temperature.

How to Avoid Common Computer Problems

  • Regular maintenance: Schedule regular cleanings and software updates.
  • Backup your data: Protect your important files with regular backups.
  • Use reliable antivirus software: Keep your system protected from malware and viruses.
  • Be cautious with downloads: Only download software from trusted sources.
  • Avoid extreme temperatures: Keep your computer away from heat sources and cold drafts.

Specific Issues and Solutions

Lenovo BIOS Issues:

  • Problem: Difficulty accessing the BIOS, boot loop, or incorrect boot order.
  • Solution:
    • Consult the Lenovo support website: Find specific troubleshooting steps for your model.
    • Use the BIOS recovery tool: Many Lenovo devices have built-in tools to recover the BIOS.
    • Update BIOS firmware: If available, update the BIOS to the latest version.

MacBook M1 Problems:

  • Problem: Overheating, battery drain, or performance issues.
  • Solution:
    • Update macOS: Keep your operating system up-to-date with the latest updates.
    • Close resource-intensive apps: Quit unnecessary applications to reduce CPU and GPU load.
    • Optimize power settings: Adjust power settings to balance performance and battery life.
    • Use cooling accessories: Consider using a cooling pad to improve airflow.

Faulty Hinges on Lenovo Laptops:

  • Problem: Loose or broken hinges can cause display issues and instability.
  • Solution:
    • Contact Lenovo support: Seek professional repair or replacement services.
    • Avoid excessive force: Be gentle when opening and closing the laptop.
    • Use a laptop stand: Reduce strain on the hinges by using a stand.

By understanding these common computer problems and following the suggested solutions, you can keep your devices running smoothly and avoid costly repairs.

In this case, there’s a little bit more hope in that it’s not a serious catastrophe.  You may have a Windows or Mac operating system corruption, PC virus infection, or hard drive issue.  Let our Indooroopilly PC and Mac repair specialists check this out for you.

My laptop gets power, but I can’t see anything on the screen.

This is usually a screen issue and we stock parts in-house for quick laptop screen replacements.  Of course, this may also mean the inverter, video connector, or other display issues are present.

My Computer Won’t Start.  What first steps should I take?

  1. First, don’t fret.  It may be an easy fix.  Make sure your plug or AC Adapter is plugged in and secure in the back of your computer.  Maybe it is loose.
  2. Secondly, make sure the other end of your power cable or charger is securely in a wall socket or power strip.  Try another outlet in case one outlet is bad.
  3. Press the power button again.  Maybe you’ll get lucky this time.
  If no luck, bring in your non-powering computer to our Computer Won’t Start Repair Taringa Computer Repair 1 location for a free diagnostic and computer repair.  Most repairs are fixed within hours.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="SSD replacement for Old Computer?"]

How to speed up an old PC with an affordable SSD?

If you have an old PC with only a mechanical hard drive inside and it's getting too slow, an SSD is a cheap and easy way to get a big speed increase. We can help you to upgrade your old computer - you can buy your parts we can install it for you.  Or we can provide parts and installation. Computer won’t start

Does your computer fail to power on?  Or the operating system isn’t loading all the way?  Maybe you see lights, but your computer is not showing anything on the screen?  Our Chapel Hill Computer Repair 1 experts will diagnose it, test all your parts and operating system to determine the exact issue and repair cost.  We are computer experts at determining non-starting computer issues.

  • Failed power supply

  • Dead motherboard
  • Overheated computer
  • Bad RAM / Memory
  • Failed processor
  • Non-working fan
  • Windows corruption
  • Virus infection
  • Dropped laptop

I’m getting no power on my computer.

This may be as simple as replacing the power supply, battery, charger or RAM.  Or you may have some critical motherboard, laptop jack, component failure.  We do all of the above and are happy to provide a free diagnostic to determine why your computer won’t power on.

My computer doesn’t load the operating system all the way.

In this case, there’s a little bit more hope in that it’s not a serious catastrophe.  You may have a Windows or Mac operating system corruption, PC virus infection, or hard drive issue.  Let our PC and Mac repair specialists check this out for you.

My laptop gets power, but I can’t see anything on the screen.

This is usually a screen issue and we stock parts in-house for quick laptop screen replacements.  Of course, this may also mean the inverter, video connector, or other display issues are present.

My Computer Won’t Start.  What first steps should I take?

  1. First, don’t fret.  It may be an easy fix.  Make sure your plug or AC Adapter is plugged in and secure in the back of your computer.  Maybe it is loose.
  2. Secondly, make sure the other end of your power cable or charger is securely in a wall socket or power strip.  Try another outlet in case one outlet is bad.
  3. Press the power button again.  Maybe you’ll get lucky this time.
  If no luck, bring in your non-powering computer to our Computer Won’t Start Repair Computer Repair 1 Chapel Hill location for a free diagnostic and computer repair.  Most repairs are fixed within hours. item.content:encoded: The Inaccessible_Boot_Device stop error can be caused by a variety of factors, including malfunctioning or corrupted filter drivers associated with the storage stack, file system corruption, alterations made to the storage controller mode or settings in the BIOS, and the use of a storage controller that differs from the one utilized during the Windows installation process. HP Inaccessible Boot Drive Problem Repair Have you ever encountered the frustrating "Inaccessible Boot Drive" error message on your HP laptop? If so, you're not alone. This is a common problem with HP laptops, particularly those that are a few years old. What causes the No Accessible Boot Drive problem? The most common cause of this problem is a faulty hard drive. Over time, the boot drive in your HP laptop can wear out and eventually die, particularly if you use your laptop heavily or store large files on it. Other possible causes include corrupt or missing system files, virus infections, and hardware malfunctions. What can we do to fix it? At our repair center, we specialize in HP laptop repairs, including the Inaccessible Boot Drive problem. Our experienced technicians can diagnose the issue and provide a range of repair options, including SSD replacement and potential data recovery. SSD Replacement and Data Recovery If your HP laptop's boot drive is the problem, we can replace it with a brand new SSD. This will not only fix the Inaccessible Boot Drive issue, but it will also improve your laptop's overall performance. Additionally, we may be able to recover your data from the old hard drive, depending on the extent of the damage. Costs The cost of repairing the No Accessible Boot Drive problem will depend on the type of SSD you need and the storage size. We use high-quality SSDs and provide a warranty on all our work, so you can be confident in the quality of our repairs. The service fee for this job is generally $150 plus parts. Contact Us If you're experiencing the No Accessible Boot Drive problem on your HP laptop, don't hesitate to contact us today. We'll diagnose the issue and provide you with an accurate quote for the repairs. Our goal is to get your HP laptop up and running as quickly as possible, so you can get back to work.

Computer won’t start - Fix Indooroopilly

Does your computer fail to power on?  Or the operating system isn’t loading all the way?  Maybe you see lights, but your computer is not showing anything on the screen?  Our Computer Repair 1 experts will diagnose it, test all your parts and operating system to determine the exact issue and repair cost.  We are computer experts at determining non-starting computer issues.

Common computer start-up issues we support:

  • Failed power supply
  • No power light
  • Failing hard drive
  • Dead motherboard
  • Overheated computer
  • Bad RAM / Memory
  • Failed processor
  • Non-working fan
  • Windows corruption
  • Virus infection
  • Dropped laptop

I’m getting no power on my computer.

This may be as simple as replacing the power supply, battery, charger or RAM.  Or you may have some critical motherboard, laptop jack, component failure.  We do all of the above and are happy to provide a free diagnostic to determine why your computer won’t power on.

My computer doesn’t load the operating system all the way.

In this case, there’s a little bit more hope in that it’s not a serious catastrophe.  You may have a Windows or Mac operating system corruption, PC virus infection, or hard drive issue.  Let our Indooroopilly PC and Mac repair specialists check this out for you.

My laptop gets power, but I can’t see anything on the screen.

This is usually a screen issue and we stock parts in-house for quick laptop screen replacements.  Of course, this may also mean the inverter, video connector, or other display issues are present.

My Computer Won’t Start.  What first steps should I take?

  1. First, don’t fret.  It may be an easy fix.  Make sure your plug or AC Adapter is plugged in and secure in the back of your computer.  Maybe it is loose.
  2. Secondly, make sure the other end of your power cable or charger is securely in a wall socket or power strip.  Try another outlet in case one outlet is bad.
  3. Press the power button again.  Maybe you’ll get lucky this time.
  If no luck, bring in your non-powering computer to our Computer Won’t Start Repair Indro Computer Repair 1 location for a free diagnostic and computer repair.  Most repairs are fixed within hours. Please note:  If your computer gets no power whatsoever, we recommend walking in for a free diagnostic.  That way, we can inform you what the cost and any necessary parts that are needed.  We are happy to come onsite, but it may require a 2-visit service if special parts need to be ordered.

[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Is it Worth to Fix Old Broken Computer?"]
Sometimes we should just recover data from old broken computer and buy new computer or buy good second hand computer (saving huge amount of money)
We recommend As they say, Aluminum / Metallic chassis laptops are more durable than plastic ones. Indeed the surrounding chassis matters, but still when choosing an aluminum chassis laptop don't forget to see what's inside the chassis, like the graphics card, processor, RAM and of course SSD.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="SSD replacement for Old Computer"]

How to speed up an old PC with an affordable SSD?

If you have an old PC with only a mechanical hard drive inside and it's getting too slow, an SSD is a cheap and easy way to get a big speed increase. We can help you to upgrade your old computer - you can buy your parts we can install it for you.  Or we can provide parts and installation. We can recovery your data from old mechanical hard drive and clone copy to new drive. item.title: Cyber-Security-Report-Bank
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.content:encoded: Cyber Security Check and Spam/Scam Cleaning Online banking has made managing your finances more convenient than ever before. However, it also carries its own set of risks. With cyber threats on the rise, it's more important than ever to ensure that your devices are protected from malware, spam, and scams. That's where our cyber security check and cleaning service comes in. What we do Our technicians will perform a deep cleaning of your computer, tablet, or phone to remove any malware, spam, or scam that may be compromising your online security. We'll also install the best internet device security software to ensure that your device stays protected in the future. Cyber Security Report As part of our service, we'll provide you with a detailed report on your bank's cyber security. This report will outline any potential risks that may exist and offer suggestions on how to mitigate those risks. The cost of this report is around $100 - $150. Preventative Measures In addition to our cyber security check and cleaning service, we'll also provide you with a quick tutorial on how to prevent online scams. We'll show you how to filter calls, emails, and text messages to avoid falling victim to phishing scams. Contact Us If you're concerned about your online security and want to ensure that your devices are protected Quick Reminder  Absolutely, it's important to be cautious of remote assistance scams. Some scammers may pose as technical support representatives and request remote access to your device through applications like TeamViewer or AnyDesk. Once they gain access, they can potentially compromise your device's security and access sensitive information like two-step verification codes, bank account information, and more. This can lead to unauthorized transactions and financial losses. It's always best to be skeptical of unsolicited offers for technical support or remote assistance. If you need technical assistance, it's recommended to reach out to a trusted and reputable company or individual. And always remember to never share sensitive information or give access to your device without verifying the legitimacy of the request.

item.title: Computer-Insurance-Claim
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.content:encoded: Computer Insurance Claim Report Service If your computer has been damaged or stolen, filing an insurance claim can help you recoup the cost of repairs or replacement. However, insurance companies often require a detailed report before they'll approve the claim. That's where our computer insurance claim report service comes in. What we do Our technicians will thoroughly examine your device to determine the extent of the damage or loss. We'll provide a detailed report outlining the cause of the damage or loss, the estimated cost of repairs or replacement, and any other relevant details needed for your insurance claim. Cost    $100 - $130 The cost of our computer insurance claim report service varies depending on the complexity of the case. However, we aim to keep our prices reasonable and competitive. We'll provide you with an estimate before we begin the service so that you know exactly what to expect. Contact Us If you need a computer insurance claim report, don't hesitate to contact us. We have the experience and expertise needed to provide you with a detailed report that will help you get the compensation you deserve.

item.title: Apple MacBook Screen Repair
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.content:encoded:
Apple MacBook Screen Repair : Everything You Need to Know

The need for Apple MacBook screen repair is a common issue faced by many users. Accidents happen, and a cracked or damaged screen can significantly impact the functionality and aesthetic appeal of a MacBook. Whether it's due to a drop, impact, or other unforeseen circumstances, a damaged screen can be a source of frustration for users who rely on their MacBook for work, study, or personal use. Fortunately, there are various options available for repairing or replacing a damaged MacBook screen. Apple offers official repair services for MacBook screens, ensuring that the replacement parts used are of high quality and compatible with the device. Additionally, many third-party repair shops provide screen repair services, often at a more affordable cost. It's essential to ensure that any service provider chosen uses genuine or equivalent quality parts to maintain the integrity of the MacBook.

Understanding MacBook Screen Issues

MacBooks are known for their high-quality displays, but like any electronic device, they are not immune to screen issues. Here are some common types of screen damage and symptoms of screen failure that MacBook users may encounter.

Types of Screen Damage

There are several types of screen damage that can occur on a MacBook. One of the most common is a cracked screen. This can happen if the MacBook is dropped or if something heavy is placed on it. Another type of screen damage is dead pixels. Dead pixels are tiny dots on the screen that do not display any color. They can be caused by manufacturing defects or physical damage to the screen. A third type of screen damage is backlight bleeding. This occurs when the backlight of the screen shines through the LCD panel, causing uneven brightness and color. It can be caused by physical damage or manufacturing defects.

Symptoms of Screen Failure

MacBook users may experience several symptoms of screen failure. One common symptom is a flickering screen. This can be caused by a loose connector or a failing backlight. Another symptom is a black screen, which can be caused by a failing LCD panel or backlight. A third symptom is distorted images or colors on the screen. This can be caused by a failing graphics card or a damaged LCD panel. Finally, some users may experience a frozen or unresponsive screen, which can be caused by a software issue or a failing hardware component. In conclusion, understanding the types of screen damage and symptoms of screen failure can help MacBook users identify and address screen issues in a timely manner. If you experience any of these issues, it is recommended to seek professional assistance to diagnose and repair the problem.

Preparation for Screen Repair

Tools and Materials Needed

Before starting the screen repair process, it is essential to gather all the necessary tools and materials. The following is a list of tools and materials that are required for a successful repair:
  • Replacement screen
  • Screwdriver set (Pentalobe and Phillips)
  • Plastic opening tools
  • Spudger
  • Suction cup
  • Microfiber cloth
  • Isopropyl alcohol
  • Adhesive strips
It is important to ensure that all the tools and materials are of high quality and compatible with the MacBook model being repaired. Using low-quality tools or materials can result in damage to the MacBook or lead to an unsuccessful repair.

Safety Precautions

Screen repair can be a delicate and risky process, and it is important to take necessary safety precautions. The following are some safety tips to keep in mind:
  • Disconnect the MacBook from power and remove the battery before starting the repair process.
  • Use an anti-static wristband to avoid damaging the MacBook with static electricity.
  • Wear protective gloves and safety glasses to protect your hands and eyes from any debris or broken glass.
  • Work on a flat and stable surface to avoid any accidental drops or damage to the MacBook.
  • Keep track of all screws and small parts during the repair process to avoid losing them.
By following these safety precautions, the repair process can be completed smoothly and safely.

Step-by-Step Repair Guide

Disassembling the MacBook

Before starting the repair, make sure to turn off the MacBook and unplug it from the power source. Then, follow these steps:
  1. Remove the bottom case screws using a Pentalobe screwdriver.
  2. Disconnect the battery connector from the logic board.
  3. Remove the display cable connector from the logic board.
  4. Remove the display assembly from the MacBook.

Removing the Damaged Screen

Once the MacBook is disassembled, follow these steps to remove the damaged screen:
  1. Remove the screws holding the screen in place.
  2. Gently lift the screen from the MacBook.
  3. Disconnect the display cable from the screen.

Installing the New Screen

Now that the old screen is removed, it's time to install the new one. Follow these steps:
  1. Connect the display cable to the new screen.
  2. Place the new screen in position and secure it with screws.
  3. Connect the display cable to the logic board.

Reassembling the MacBook

With the new screen installed, it's time to put the MacBook back together. Follow these steps:
  1. Reconnect the battery connector to the logic board.
  2. Reconnect the display cable connector to the logic board.
  3. Place the display assembly back onto the MacBook.
  4. Secure the bottom case with screws using a Pentalobe screwdriver.
By following these steps, anyone can repair their Apple MacBook screen. However, if you're not confident in your abilities, it's always best to seek professional help.

DIY Repair Tips

Repairing a MacBook screen can be a daunting task, but with the right tools and knowledge, it can be done at home. Here are some DIY repair tips to help you troubleshoot common problems and ensure proper alignment.

Troubleshooting Common Problems

Before attempting any repairs, it's important to identify the problem with the MacBook screen. Some common issues include a cracked or broken screen, dead pixels, and backlight problems. If the screen is cracked or broken, it will need to be replaced. Dead pixels can be fixed by using a pixel fixing software or by gently massaging the affected area with a soft cloth. Backlight problems can be caused by a faulty inverter or backlight, which will need to be replaced.

Ensuring Proper Alignment

Proper alignment is crucial when repairing a MacBook screen. If the screen is not properly aligned, it can cause issues such as a distorted image or a non-responsive touchpad. To ensure proper alignment, use a guide or template to line up the screen before attaching it to the MacBook. It's also important to use the correct screws and tools to avoid damaging the MacBook or the screen. In addition, make sure to test the screen before fully reassembling the MacBook. This will help identify any issues early on and prevent further damage. By following these DIY repair tips, anyone can repair a MacBook screen at home with confidence and ease. However, if you're not comfortable with DIY repairs, it's always best to seek professional help to avoid causing further damage.

Professional Repair Services

MacBook screens are delicate and can easily crack or break. When this happens, it's important to find a reliable and professional repair service to fix the issue. In this section, we'll discuss how to choose a service provider and the cost of professional repair.

Choosing a Service Provider

When choosing a service provider for your MacBook screen repair, it's important to do your research. Look for a company with a good reputation and positive customer reviews. Check if the service provider is authorized by Apple to perform repairs. Authorized service providers use genuine Apple parts and have certified technicians who are trained to repair Apple products. Another factor to consider is the turnaround time. Ask the service provider how long the repair will take and if they offer any expedited service options. A good repair service should be able to provide an estimate of the repair cost and time frame before starting the repair.

Cost of Professional Repair

The cost of MacBook screen repair can vary depending on the model and the extent of the damage. According to IT-Tech Online, a MacBook Pro screen replacement can cost between $200 to $1200, while a MacBook Air screen replacement can cost between $320 to $850. It's important to note that professional repair services may be more expensive than DIY repair options. However, DIY repair can be risky and may cause further damage to the device. It's recommended to choose a professional repair service to ensure the repair is done correctly and with genuine parts. In conclusion, choosing a reliable and authorized service provider is crucial for MacBook screen repair. While the cost may be higher than DIY repair options, it's worth the investment to ensure the device is repaired correctly and with genuine parts.

Warranty and Apple Support

If you're experiencing issues with your MacBook's screen, the first thing you should check is whether your device is still under warranty. Apple offers a limited warranty that covers hardware defects and malfunctions for up to one year from the date of purchase. If your MacBook is still within this period, you may be eligible for a free repair or replacement.

Understanding AppleCare

For those who want extended coverage, Apple offers an optional service plan called AppleCare. This plan extends the warranty for up to three years from the date of purchase and covers not only hardware defects but also accidental damage. However, it's important to note that AppleCare does not cover intentional damage, such as dropping or smashing your MacBook. AppleCare also provides access to Apple's technical support team, who can help troubleshoot issues with your device. They can assist with software problems, connectivity issues, and other non-hardware related problems. Additionally, AppleCare includes coverage for up to two incidents of accidental damage, subject to a service fee.

Claiming Warranty Service

If your MacBook is still under warranty and you're experiencing issues with the screen, the first step is to contact Apple support. They will help diagnose the issue and determine whether your device is eligible for a repair or replacement. If your device is eligible, you'll need to send it to an authorized Apple repair center. If you have AppleCare, you can contact the support team directly to initiate a repair request. They will guide you through the process and provide you with a shipping label to send your device to the repair center. Once the repair is complete, your device will be returned to you. In summary, it's important to understand the warranty and AppleCare options available for your MacBook. If you're experiencing issues with your screen, check your warranty status and contact Apple support for assistance. With the right coverage and support, you can ensure your MacBook remains in top condition.

Aftercare and Maintenance

Screen Cleaning Techniques

Regular cleaning of the MacBook screen can help maintain its appearance and reduce the risk of damage. Before cleaning, turn off the MacBook and unplug it from the power source. Use a soft, lint-free cloth to wipe the screen gently. Avoid using abrasive materials or harsh chemicals that can scratch or damage the screen. For stubborn stains, dampen the cloth with water or a 50/50 mixture of water and white vinegar. Do not spray liquid directly onto the screen. Instead, apply the solution to the cloth and wipe the screen gently. Avoid using excessive pressure or rubbing motions that can damage the screen.

Preventative Measures

Preventative measures can help reduce the risk of damage to the MacBook screen. Avoid placing heavy objects on top of the MacBook or closing the screen with objects such as pens or pencils on the keyboard. Use a protective case or sleeve to protect the MacBook during transport. Additionally, avoid exposing the MacBook to extreme temperatures or direct sunlight for extended periods. Store the MacBook in a cool, dry place when not in use. Regular maintenance can help extend the life of the MacBook screen and reduce the need for repairs. If the MacBook screen does become damaged, it is important to seek professional repair services from a reputable provider.

Alternative Solutions

Using External Monitors

If the MacBook screen is damaged beyond repair or the cost of repair is too high, an alternative solution is to use an external monitor. This is a cost-effective solution that allows you to continue using your MacBook without the need for a screen replacement. To use an external monitor with your MacBook, you will need a compatible monitor and a cable to connect it to your MacBook. Most modern monitors use HDMI or DisplayPort cables, which can be easily connected to your MacBook using an adapter. Using an external monitor can also improve your productivity by providing a larger display area and better resolution. This is especially useful for graphic designers, video editors, and other professionals who require a high-quality display.

Trade-In and Upgrade Options

If your MacBook is outdated or damaged beyond repair, you may consider trading it in for a new model or upgrading the components. Apple offers a trade-in program that allows you to exchange your old MacBook for a newer model at a discounted price. Upgrading your MacBook's components, such as the RAM or SSD, can also improve its performance and extend its lifespan. This is a cost-effective solution that can be done by a professional technician or by following online tutorials. Before considering a trade-in or upgrade, it is important to evaluate the cost and benefits of each option. Upgrading your MacBook may be more cost-effective than buying a new one, but it may not be worth the investment if the damage is extensive. Overall, using external monitors and trade-in/upgrade options are alternative solutions to consider when repairing a damaged MacBook screen. It is important to evaluate the pros and cons of each option and choose the one that best suits your needs and budget.

Legal Considerations

Warranty Voiding Risks

Attempting to repair a MacBook screen on your own or by a third-party repair service may void the device's warranty. Apple's warranty policy clearly states that any unauthorized repair or modification of the device will render the warranty invalid. This means that if you attempt to repair the screen yourself or take it to a non-authorized repair service, you will not be eligible for any free repairs or replacements under the warranty.

Consumer Rights and Protections

In Australia, consumers are protected by the Australian Consumer Law (ACL), which provides certain guarantees for goods and services purchased. These guarantees include that the goods must be of acceptable quality, fit for purpose, and match the description provided. If the MacBook screen is faulty or not of acceptable quality, the consumer is entitled to a repair, replacement, or refund from the seller or manufacturer. However, it is important to note that if the MacBook screen is damaged due to misuse or accidental damage, the consumer is not entitled to a repair, replacement, or refund under the ACL. In this case, the consumer may need to pay for the repair or replacement themselves or through their insurance policy. It is recommended that consumers refer to the ACL and seek legal advice if they are unsure about their rights and protections when it comes to MacBook screen repair. Additionally, consumers should always check the warranty policy and terms and conditions before attempting any repairs or modifications on their MacBook.

Future of MacBook Screens

Innovations in Screen Technology

Apple has always been at the forefront of innovation when it comes to their MacBook screens. With the introduction of Retina Displays, the screens on MacBooks have become brighter, sharper, and more vibrant. In the future, Apple is expected to continue pushing the boundaries of screen technology. One area where Apple may focus on is improving the refresh rate of their MacBook screens. A higher refresh rate can make scrolling and animations smoother, which can greatly enhance the user experience. Apple may also explore the use of MicroLED technology, which can offer even better color accuracy and energy efficiency compared to OLED.

Predictions for Upcoming Models

As for upcoming MacBook models, there are rumors that Apple may release a foldable MacBook with a nearly "crease-free" screen. 1 While this is still just a rumor, if true, it could revolutionize the way we use our laptops. A foldable MacBook could offer the portability of a tablet with the productivity of a laptop. Another prediction for upcoming MacBook models is the use of mini-LED technology. 2 Mini-LED displays can offer better contrast and brightness compared to traditional LCD displays, while still being more energy-efficient than OLED. If Apple were to adopt mini-LED displays, we could see even better screens on future MacBook models. Overall, the future of MacBook screens looks bright. Apple has a track record of pushing the boundaries of screen technology, and we can expect to see even more exciting innovations in the years to come.

Footnotes

  1. MacRumors ↩
  2. 9to5Mac ↩

We service all major brands and custom-built desktops with a fast, efficient approach. Laptop Repair From cracked screens to battery issues, our experts specialize in all types of laptop repairs. We understand the importance of portability, so we’re here to ensure your laptop is running smoothly, wherever you go. Data Recovery Lost files can be devastating, whether they’re personal memories or essential business documents. Our data recovery services are designed to retrieve lost or corrupted data from various devices, helping you recover what matters most. Virus Removal Protecting your devices from malware, viruses, and cyber threats is crucial. Our virus removal service not only clears your system but also strengthens your defenses against future attacks, giving you peace of mind. Network Setup A strong, stable network is the backbone of any home or office setup. We offer expert network configuration and setup services, making sure all your devices stay seamlessly connected. IT Support For both individuals and businesses, we provide dependable IT support that keeps your technology working smoothly. From troubleshooting to advanced support, we’re just a call away to tackle any tech issue you may encounter. Managed IT Services Our managed IT services allow businesses to operate without the stress of managing their own technology. We handle everything from maintenance to security, giving you the freedom to focus on growth and productivity. Each of our services is designed with the Brisbane community in mind. With transparent pricing, free consultations, and expert guidance, we make computer repair easy, accessible, and dependable.

Computer Repairs Brisbane – Your Reliable Local Service for All Your Computer Needs

When your computer or laptop needs attention, it’s important to find reliable, efficient, and affordable repair services in Brisbane. At Computer Repair 1, we specialize in everything from liquid-damaged laptop repairs to data recovery, virus removal, and computer maintenance. Our skilled technicians provide same-day and on-site computer repair options for your convenience. Whether you’re dealing with a cracked Mac screen, a gaming PC issue, or a no-boot error, our experienced team is here to help.

Comprehensive Laptop Repairs in Brisbane

If your laptop has sustained damage, our repair services cover a wide range of issues:
  • Liquid Damaged Laptop Repair: Accidents happen! Liquid spills on laptops can cause severe internal damage. Our technicians carefully clean and assess affected components, performing specialized repairs to restore your laptop’s functionality.
  • Cracked Mac Screen Repair & Replacement: A broken MacBook screen can disrupt your work. We offer quick, quality Mac screen replacements, including for models like the A2337 MacBook Air.
  • Laptop Battery Replacement: We replace batteries for all major brands, including HP, Dell, Lenovo, Asus, and Apple. If your laptop isn’t holding a charge, a battery replacement could be the answer.
  • Laptop Charging Port & DC-In Port Repair: Charging issues are common but often solvable with a port replacement. Our services restore reliable charging for laptops suffering from loose or broken ports.
  • Laptop Hinge Replacement: Broken hinges make it difficult to open or close your laptop safely. We replace hinges for all major brands, restoring the strength and flexibility of your device.

Desktop Computer Repairs and Custom Builds

Our Brisbane technicians also specialize in desktop computer repairs. Whether it’s a custom-built PC with unique specifications or a pre-built model from a major brand, we provide diagnostic services and solutions for any issue, from blue screen errors to component upgrades.
  • Gaming PC Repair: Gaming PCs require special care and maintenance. We repair components like GPUs, CPUs, and cooling systems to keep your gaming setup running smoothly.
  • Virus & Malware Removal: Protecting your computer from malicious software is crucial. We remove viruses, malware, and phishing threats, and can even set up anti-scam protections to secure your device.

Data Recovery Services in Brisbane - Computer Repairs Brisbane

Losing important data can be distressing, whether it’s a result of hardware failure, accidental deletion, or liquid damage. Our data recovery services are designed to retrieve lost files from laptops, desktops, and external drives. We specialize in:
  • External Drive Data Recovery: We can recover data from external drives, USB drives, and SSDs.
  • Lost File Data Recovery: Even if files have been deleted, we may be able to recover them depending on your device and the data’s condition.

Cyber Security and Digital Security Services

With digital threats on the rise, cyber security is essential. We offer comprehensive cyber security reports to assess your computer’s vulnerability and provide solutions, including anti-scam computer setups for added protection.
  • Cyber Security and Digital Security Reports: Our digital security assessments provide insights into your device's security status, ensuring your data and privacy are protected from evolving online threats.

Apple Mac Repairs: Screen, Battery, and Spill Damage

As a specialist in Apple device repairs, we offer several services specifically for MacBooks:
  • Apple Mac Spill Damage Repair: We handle liquid damage on MacBooks by cleaning and drying internal components, with repairs or replacements as needed.
  • A2337 MacBook Air Screen Replacement: For cracked or damaged screens, we replace screens quickly and accurately to restore your Mac’s display to its best quality.

Professional On-Site and Urgent Repair Services

Our on-site services bring the repair shop to your home or office, ideal for businesses, students, or seniors needing convenient tech support. We also provide same-day and urgent repair options to address critical issues promptly.
  • Student Laptop Repair Discounts: We understand students rely on their laptops, so we offer special discounts to make repairs affordable.
  • Senior Computer Support: Our patient, friendly technicians provide support tailored to seniors, whether it’s basic troubleshooting or in-depth guidance.

Laptop Maintenance and Cleaning Services

Keeping your laptop clean can prevent overheating and hardware issues. We offer laptop cleaning services for fans, screens, keyboards, and ports to extend your device’s lifespan.
  • Laptop Fan Replacement: Overheating can damage components over time. Our technicians can replace fans to improve airflow and protect your laptop from overheating.

Common Computer Issues We Repair

We handle various computer problems that may be affecting your productivity:
  • No Bootable Drive Error Repair: This common issue can be resolved with our diagnostic and repair services, which address both software and hardware issues that prevent your computer from booting.
  • Blue Screen Error Repair: Our technicians specialize in identifying the cause of blue screen errors, whether they’re due to software conflicts, faulty hardware, or driver issues.
  • Laptop Motherboard Replacement and Short Circuit Repair: Motherboard issues can be complex, but our experts have experience repairing or replacing motherboards for major brands, ensuring your laptop works reliably again.

Affordable and Transparent Pricing

We believe in honest, straightforward pricing, charging based on the job rather than hourly rates. For more specialized repairs, such as laptop screen replacement costs or liquid-damaged laptop repair costs, we provide clear quotes so there are no surprises.

Insurance Claim Reports and Beyond Repair Assessments

When a device is beyond repair or damaged due to an accident, we provide computer insurance claim reports to help you file claims easily. For devices that can’t be restored, our beyond repair reports offer confirmation for insurance and replacement purposes.
Why Choose Computer Repair 1 for Computer Repairs in Brisbane? Our commitment to fast, reliable service and a client-first approach makes us a top choice for computer repairs in Brisbane. We take pride in serving Brisbane and the surrounding suburbs with:
  • Expert Technicians: Our skilled team stays up-to-date with the latest technology, offering expert repairs for all brands and models.
  • Quick Turnaround Times: Many repairs are completed within a day, with options for urgent, same-day service.
  • Transparent, Affordable Pricing: Fair, clear pricing with no hidden fees ensures peace of mind.

item.title: Apple Mac Repair Brisbane
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row][vc_column width="2/3"][wdc_heading title="Apple Mac Repair Brisbane"]Quick Fix | Water Damaged Mac Repair | Fast Return | Brisbane[/wdc_heading][vc_column_text]

Mac Repairs Brisbane

We love Apple and the fantastic products they create and we pride ourselves in being experts at fixing all things Mac. Stop in for an affordable, speedy reliable Mac repairs service in Brisbane. You may bring your Apple device to our one of our computer repair shop for a free diagnostic and quick turn-around. If you prefer to have an CR1 Mac repair technician come to you, contact us to schedule same-day IT service.

Here are some real customer scenarios:

My Mac is so slow.

Slow boot up and constant pinwheeling could indicate a problem with your Mac. At Computer Repair 1, you may drop in at your convenience with no appointment necessary. Time is of the essence and we get that. Your Mac needs help and we want to fix it right away for you.

My MacBook doesn’t turn on.

We’ll be happy to provide a free on-the-spot diagnostic for all power-related issues. We are able to directly repair the logic board and perform part replacements to help get you back up and running. Just need an adapter? We sell those too. We provide data recovery. Cheapest Mac Repair in Brisbane.

I just spilled water on my MacBook Air. Can you help?

Computer Repair 1 routinely performs Mac spill clean repairs and is able to save you hundreds of dollars by directly removing the spill damage. Further, data recovery is one of our specialties if you simply need your stuff back. Same Day Macbook Repair in Brisbane.

My iMac needs a repair.

Can you come to my home or office? Computer Repair 1 gladly has a urgent team that will be able to assist you in the same day. (no surcharge extra fee for same day repairs) We repair or replace your Logicboard - Screen - Charging Port - Battery - Black Screen - White Screen Problems. We recover your Data or replace your Mac Drive. SSD Replacement - Image Copy - Data Recovery

I need to upgrade my MacBook.

If You want to extend the life of your MacBook and we’re here to help achieve that, regardless of its age. At Computer Repair 1, we are service-focused and will do everything in our power to repair, upgrade, and save your precious MacBook. Increasing Storage on your MacBook doesnt hurt your pocket. We provide most affordable Apple Computer Repairs.

Most Common Mac Problems

Affordable Professional Services with top quality support

Tell us a little about what's going on and we'll help you get the repair you need.

  • Startup Issues: If your Mac fails to boot properly and you find yourself staring at a blank screen or gray startup screen or (flashing question mark).
  • Switching is slow: slow or freezing, ram issues, beeping, overheating mac.
  • Lost files, startup bugs, slow downs and Mac crashes fixed.
  • Mac wont start. A total lack of response to the power button could mean a blown fuse in the plug, so check first. If it's not completely dead, the Mac will do a 'power-on self-test' (POST) as it boots up, and beep if it finds a fault. The power LED may flash too.
  • Need to rescue my files (Data Recovery) - BootCamp Issues. Corrupt Data, Malwares Problem.
  • Mac starts, but stops, Startup might stall with a plain blue or grey screen, a flashing question mark, a broken folder icon, or – rarely – a 'sad Mac'. Sometimes, especially in the last instance, you may have a hardware problem.
  • My Hard disk is Full: Running out of room on your hard disk may manifest itself in an alert box warning that it's 'nearly full.
  • Hardware Problems with Macbook: No Audio, TrackPad not Clicking, TrackPad and Keyboard not working. SSD replacement, Liquid Damage, Water Damaged Macbook, Wine Spill, Milk Spill, Water Spill Macbook.
  • Macbook is not charging. Black Screen. Mac not turning on.
  • Macbook Problem after update.
  • macbook is beeping and won't turn on

item.title: Fraser K.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Fantastic service. Ike repaired my laptop within two hours backing up my hard drive and completely refurbishing my computer within 1 hour on a Sunday!! What a legend. He has also offered fantastic advice for future computer needs. Don’t go anywhere else. This is the best price and the best service you will find.

item.title: Cheryl C.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: I have now used this company on several occasions & find Ike, the technician to be fantastic. He's very knowledgeable, helpful & prompt. His prices are extremely good & he's a real gentleman. I Highly recommend him.

item.title: Luke Ed.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Came to Ike on the early morning of a Saturday to ask for assistance and he managed to fix my water damaged macbook pro within an hour for an extremely reasonable price. Very trustworthy and down to earth guy who clearly has an exceptional knowledge of computers. Would recommend him to everyone I know.

item.title: Grace Mc.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Absolutely fantastic service, definitely recommend! I was able to get my computer seen to straight away and fixed within the hour. Amazing service; gave great advice for future issues that may arise, and had my computer fixed for a very low cost- the cheapest of all other quotes I had heard. I have already been recommending Ike to my friends if they ever need a computer expert! Thankyou again Ike for saving my laptop!

item.title: Chris C.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Fast, fair, and works on Sunday! A+++, highly recommended. Ike gives you step by step details of what he is doing. He embodies everything good about small businesses - especially the customer service

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: PhD Student, University of Queensland, St. Lucia

item.title: Mortimer D.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Excellent service, I would highly recommend to anyone looking to get their computer fixed. Quick repair times and honest about my options, even if it could have cost business. 5/5!

item.title: Nathan B.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: Ike was amazing. My partner and I are not computer savvy but Ike took his time and went through everything with us and gave us lots of incredible advice. He even saw us after hours with short notice. Definitely recommend choosing him for all your laptop needs.

item.title: Sarah T.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: I just had my laptop resurrected and the engineer was fantastic. Very patient, very knowledgeable and knew exactly what he was doing. If I ever have another computer problem, I will definitely give these guys a call. They are professionals and they have great customer service. Great price, First he advised me to call all other local computer repair technicians and ask final price, he was right, Ike offered me the cheapest fee. Great job, thanks a lot!

item.title: Robert V.
item.dc:creator: aykut
item.excerpt:encoded: I found Ike to be most helpful and knowledgeable.His prices are very reasonable and would reccomend him without any reservations.His knowledge of computers and mobiles is outstanding.
